name: operator-note-tone
description: Hand-labelled statements for the only judgement the model makes in this task. Half of the cases are real notes taken verbatim from the sensor archive, half are written to probe the failure modes that matter: negation ('nothing suggests a fault condition' is healthy), vocabulary that merely names a fault, notes that mix a healthy opening with a worried ending, and text that asserts nothing at all. Roughly balanced across the three verdicts so a classifier cannot score well by favouring one of them.
